Priya (Marketing Ops): Quick sync on 'Hallway Labs' virtual demo — June 14. Goal: finalize registration page, Zoom recording + SRT delivery, replay gating, and inbound lead routing by Wed COB. Key asks: two CTAs, company-size funnel, SRT + cloud transcript, 12d open replay then gated, clip owners.
Jonah (Growth): CTA suggestion: primary 'Reserve my seat' (prominent), secondary 'Request a pilot' (visible when company_size == 500+). Mobile shows primary only.
Mei (Design): Uploaded hero and mobile variants to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/hallwaylabs/hero-preview. Trimmed form to 6 fields.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Form fields: first_name, last_name, email, company, company_size dropdown (<50 / 50-500 / 500+), role, gdpr_consent required. Hidden field: source_detail = "hallway_labs_jun14". Add ICS + Google Calendar buttons.
Rafael (Events): Zoom plan: create meeting, enable cloud recording + audio transcript, and check 'Optimize for 3rd party captions' for SRT. Also local host recording as fallback. SRT ingest endpoint: srt://ingest.redwood.example:9022/hallway14.
ZoomBot: Meeting created https://zoom.us/j/1122334455 (ID: 112-233-4455). SRT test scheduled Jun 12 09:30 PT.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Replay policy: Day 0-12 public replay link. Day 13 -> gated (email unlock) and full download available to gated users. Clips remain public after gating. Jonah will draft gated landing copy.
Jonah (Growth): Post-event cadence: 0-24h: send replay link + CTA to schedule pilot; Day 5: highlight clips; Day 13: gated download + long-form follow-up; AE nudge for 500+ leads at Day 2 if attended.
Aisha (Sales): For 500+ leads, please include a brief note: 'interested in production-grade inference latency/cost' in AE starter note. Also send Slack AE alert when attended_live == true.
Priya (Marketing Ops): HubSpot mapping: lead_source, event_name, company_size_segment, source_detail, gdpr_consent. Hidden numeric field: company_employee_count. Save consent boolean to gdpr_consent.
Jonah (Growth): Attendance rule: joined >= 6 minutes -> attended_live = true via Zoom webhook to HS. Also tag attendees with 'attended:hallway_labs_jun14'.
Mei (Design): Thumbnails: need speaker headshots and three crop sizes (16:9, 4:5, 1:1). Who owns clips?
Rafael (Events): I'll own extraction and timecode notes during the session. Jonah  you'll own final clip titles and metadata.
Priya (Marketing Ops): CSV export fields for ops: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size_segment, company_employee_count, utm_campaign, registration_ts, session_id, attended_live. Daily HS sync.
Jonah (Growth): Add hidden field campaign_channel = "organic_email" option for our promo links so we can split test later.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Privacy copy (GDPR): "I agree to receive event-related emails and content from Redwood Inference." Required checkbox. Devs: include validation and persist to HS.
Rafael (Events): Infra confirmed: port 9022 open from Zoom IP ranges. I'll run SRT end-to-end test Jun 12 and a dry-run Jun 13 10:00 PT with hosts. ZoomBot: SRT dry-run scheduled Jun 13 10:00 PT.
Mei (Design): Also add a small microcopy under the form: 'Open replay available for 12 days' and deliver thumbnails by Jun 11 EOD.
Aisha (Sales): Can we add a boolean field 'high_priority' for 500+ who also self-report 'evaluating vendors' in the role/intent question? That would surface nested leads.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Yes add intent dropdown with options: Exploratory / Evaluating vendors / Curious. Map 'Evaluating vendors' + company_size==500+ -> high_priority = true. Save as HS property high_priority.
Jonah (Growth): Runbook: lock reg page + email copy by Mon 12pm PT. Dress rehearsal Jun 13 10:00 PT. Rafael will push recordings to S3 and mark retention policy: copy to S3 immediately; public link until day 12; after day 12 move to gated S3 bucket with signed URLs.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Ownership recap: Priya = registration + HS fields + consent copy; Mei = hero + thumbnails; Rafael = Zoom + clips + SRT + S3 push; Jonah = email sequences + HS routing + runbook; Aisha = AE brief + follow-up play.
Jonah (Growth): Devil's advocate: what's fallback if SRT fails?
Rafael (Events): Fallback: rely on Zoom cloud transcript + local host recording; capture VTT/SRT from cloud, then post-process timestamps. We'll surface a note in the runbook.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Please react with :thumbsup: when your Asana task is complete so I can close the ticket.
Mei (Design): :thumbsup:
Rafael (Events): :thumbsup:
Aisha (Sales): :thumbsup:
